summary: E11 Driver Payroll RBAC fix verification completed successfully. All 4 test scenarios passed: (1) Driver role completely blocked from Finance page with redirect to dashboard, (2) Owner has full access to Finance page with Payroll tab, (3) Payout Detail Dialog displays all components correctly with bonus/deduction sections and slip export buttons, (4) New payout generation working with duplicate prevention. Backend remains 100% functional (68/68 tests). CRITICAL RBAC issue from iteration_41 is now RESOLVED.

backend_issues.notes: Backend remains 100% functional. No retest needed as per agent context.
